issues.description: The visibility of the REST handler for listing all persons is inconsistent between template and solution. The template declares the method getAllPersons() as public (exposed endpoint), while the solution declares it as private. This mismatch can confuse students about the expected visibility of controller handler methods and could lead to uncertainty whether handler methods must be public for Spring MVC mapping to work.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility of the getAllPersons() handler consistent across template and solution. Prefer declaring controller handler methods as public in both template and solution (e.g., change the solution's private ResponseEntity<List<Person>> getAllPersons() to public) to match typical Spring MVC expectations and avoid student confusion.
